preregistration_metadata.title: Phase 11: Preregistered Bayesian-LoRA Replication + Prospective Prediction Freeze
preregistration_metadata.purpose: Evaluate whether the preserved Bayesian-LoRA training procedure reproduces the historically useful uncertainty behavior, and freeze newly trained models for prospective evaluation.
preregistration_metadata.scientific_distinction: This is a NEW replication experiment. It is NOT a continuation of the original fitted models.

frozen_training_recipe.early_stopping: best state dict by validation AUROC across 4 epochs

secondary_criteria.historical_m13_timing_delta_utility: Delta U = mean(u_net(M13_H4)) - mean(u_net(M8_H4)) > 0 on historical benchmark

predeclared_replication_success_criteria.reporting_rule: Report Seed 42, Seed 123, Seed 777 separately, plus 3-seed arithmetic mean. No best-seed selection permitted.

frozen_portfolio_architecture.transaction_costs: 10 bps on actual traded risky turnover

prospective_evaluation_and_outcome_tree.architecture_endpoint: M8_H4 vs M8_H1 (testing cohort stacking generalization)
prospective_evaluation_and_outcome_tree.right_censoring_rule: Include only events with a complete H=4 realized path based purely on calendar completeness.

outcome_tree.Outcome A: Training procedure replicates historically AND prospective M13 is positive (Strongest result).
outcome_tree.Outcome B: Historical procedure replicates, prospective timing weak/negative (Historical phenomenon reproducible but does not generalize prospectively).
outcome_tree.Outcome C: Historical replication itself fails (Original result depended strongly on lost fitted checkpoints).
outcome_tree.Outcome D: Cohort H4 confirms, timing does not.
outcome_tree.Outcome F: Data or provenance integrity prevents valid prospective evaluation.

approved_phrasing: prospective evaluation of newly trained preregistered models
